question: What was total revenue in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

question: Revenue by region in 2025
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.name

question: Top 5 customers by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the monthly revenue trend for 2025

gold_sql.sqlite: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS m, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m
gold_sql.postgres: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', o.order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS m, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

question: How many orders did each plant get in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN plants p ON p.plant_id = o.plant_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY p.name

question: Which transporter has the worst on-time delivery rate?
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivery_date <= s.promised_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM shipments s JOIN transporters t ON t.transporter_id = s.transporter_id WHERE s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1

question: On-time delivery % by transporter
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivery_date <= s.promised_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM shipments s JOIN transporters t ON t.transporter_id = s.transporter_id WHERE s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.name

question: How many orders did the Pune Plant get in March 2026?

question: Freight cost by transporter

question: Average order value by customer segment
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.segment

gold_sql.sqlite: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS q, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id WHERE pr.category = 'Pumps' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY q ORDER BY q
gold_sql.postgres: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int || '-Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_date)::int AS q, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id WHERE pr.category = 'Pumps' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY q ORDER BY q

question: How many late shipments did Om Sai Transport have in 2025?
